items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I played the lunch with Albert Corson.

ctx.x: No, it's a Sazerac one. The Sazerac one? Yeah. And the coffee shop is now Bailey's.

Yeah, well, they used to open it up on Saturday night at nighttime. They used to go all the way over to Barone Street. So I played double headers in there. I played the lunch with Albert Corson. I worked with about a half a dozen bands at nighttime. And I stayed in the hotel. I just didn't have to worry about anything. You stayed in a room in the hotel?
